character_description: Ashoka, emperor with features showing his evolution—bearing marks of warrior-king past (scars, powerful build), gradually transforming into sage (serene expression, glowing spiritual luminescence). Dark hair showing natural aging with dignity. Eyes reflecting shifting from conquering ambition to compassionate wisdom.
setting: Ancient India—battlefields, palaces, and sacred spaces of enlightenment
theme: The possibility of radical transformation through recognizing consequences of power

video_prompts: Ashoka as young warrior-king, achieving military victory through savage conquest. His power seems absolute but hollow.
first_frame_prompt: Ashoka stands over conquered kingdom, victorious yet unsatisfied. His scars glow with past battles. Dark hair flows with warrior's intensity. Eyes burn with ambition for more conquest. Spiritual luminescence is absent—only cold power radiates from him. Victory tastes like ash despite its magnitude.
speech: I have conquered kingdoms. Yet something within me remains conquered still.
